data.title: Elysian Mansions
data.about:
Introducing Elysian Mansions at Tilal Al Ghaf, a project of Majid Al Futtaim Community. Which is inspired by the Elysian Fields of Greek mythology. 

Bespoke and tailored luxury in the form of Lagoonside, Hilltop or Parklane homes. Choose from 5-7 bedroom options. These homes are spacious and offer you the highest level of luxurious lifestyle. Paired with the best waterfront community living and amenities, this is where you can live the high-end lifetyle you deserve.
